appDescription: A community app for reporting road conditions to nearby drivers.

function.name: GAZEE_CREATE_REPORT
function.description: Hands a road report to the app for registration. Call this action using the details the driver gave, even when the place or situation is missing. Do not ask the driver to supply missing details before calling it.

reportTitle.description: A concise Korean title using the driver's stated place and situation when provided. A partial title is valid when a detail is missing. Exclude assistant and app names and registration commands. Preserve stated uncertainty, negation, direction, and timing without adding facts.

location.description: The road or place named by the driver, as broadly or specifically as stated. Do not infer a location or ask for a more detailed location.

condition.description: The observed situation explicitly described by the driver, preserving negation and uncertainty. An empty string indicates no situation was provided.

utterance.description: The driver's latest report request in their original words, including its app invocation and wording even if the location or condition is missing.

function.name: GAZEE_READ_RECEIVED_REPORT
function.description: Reads the latest received GAZEE report aloud using the announcement returned by the app.
